basis.note: There is no official ranking of the world's most beautiful places. The order below is an editorial selection made for presentation, not a published score or vote.
basis.selection: Ten places chosen for global recognition and visual contrast across terrain types (island, desert, savanna, alpine, lagoon, caldera coast, rainforest falls).

facts: Only stable, verifiable figures are shown: UNESCO inscription years, park establishment dates, altitudes, island counts and the published fall count for Iguazu.

flags.license: Flags are public domain in most jurisdictions; see https://flagcdn.com

imagery.status: One Creative-Commons / public-domain photograph bundled per place.
imagery.provider: Openverse (https://openverse.org) — search, selection and download by scripts/fetch_place_photos.py.
imagery.credits: public/places/photos.json lists the title, creator, licence, source link and detail URL for every photo.
imagery.selection: Tall, high-resolution, permissively licensed images whose titles describe the place; resort, map, poster and trail shots are excluded.
imagery.fallback: If an image path is missing, the card renders generated terrain art (see src/places/PlaceCard.tsx).
imagery.swapping: Replace public/places/<rank>-<slug>.jpg (or change `image` in src/places/data.ts), then re-render.

narration.elevenlabs: Key in .env is valid for text-to-speech but has 0 credits remaining (quota_exceeded); regenerate with ElevenLabs after topping up by re-running scripts/voiceover_places.py.

audio.licensing: Music and SFX generated in-repo. Narration via the edge-tts fallback voice (Microsoft neural TTS).
